answer: In Proof of Agent, sybil resistance binds staked collateral to Semaphore trees via polynomial identity commitments. Each epoch, a node wields its secret key like a quill to evaluate a Rate-Limiting Nullifier polynomial. Single signals preserve anonymity, but duplicate messaging, like a bifurcating comet, exposes two shares. Shamir secret sharing cracks this walnut, reconstructing the private key and executing instantaneous slashing.
